import json
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.assets.suitability import (
    get_asset_suitability_engine,
    get_asset_suitability_review,
    SuitabilityRequest,
)

class Hou_Mcp_Asset_Selection_Report(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_asset_selection_report"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("candidates_json",   "string", widget_type="text", default="[]")
        self.add_input("environment",       "string", widget_type="text", default="western_room")
        self.add_input("role",              "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("placement_context", "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_output("report_json",      "string")
        self.add_output("production_ready", "bool")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        raw = (inputs.get("candidates_json") or "").strip()
        environment = (inputs.get("environment") or "").strip()
        role = (inputs.get("role") or "").strip()
        placement_context = (inputs.get("placement_context") or "").strip()

        try:
            candidates = json.loads(raw) if raw else []
        except Exception:
            self.log_error("candidates_json is not valid JSON.")
            return {"report_json": "{}", "production_ready": False, "exec_out": True}

        try:
            eng = get_asset_suitability_engine()
            rev = get_asset_suitability_review()
            req = SuitabilityRequest(
                environment=environment,
                role=role,
                placement_context=placement_context,
            )
            result = eng.rank_assets(candidates, req)
            review = rev.review(result)

            report = result.selection_report
            report["review"] = review.to_dict()

            lines = [
                "-" * 50,
                f"ASSET SELECTION REPORT",
                f"  Environment: {environment}   Role: {role or '(any)'}   Placement: {placement_context or '(any)'}",
                f"  Candidates: {result.total_candidates}   Rejected: {result.rejected_count}",
            ]
            if result.best:
                lines.append(f"  SELECTED: {result.best.asset_name}  score={result.best.final_score:.3f}")
                lines.append(f"    env={result.best.environment_score:.2f}  role={result.best.role_score:.2f}  style={result.best.style_score:.2f}")
                lines.append(f"    mat={result.best.material_score:.2f}  scale={result.best.scale_score:.2f}  place={result.best.placement_score:.2f}  story={result.best.story_score:.2f}")
            else:
                lines.append("  SELECTED: (none)")
            lines.append("  --- All Candidates ---")
            for s in result.scores:
                lines.append(f"  {s.asset_name}: {s.final_score:.3f}")
            lines.append(f"  Review: grade={review.grade}  score={review.overall_score:.2f}  production_ready={review.production_ready}")
            if review.findings:
                for f in review.findings:
                    lines.append(f"    FINDING: {f}")
            lines.append("-" * 50)
            self.log_info("\n".join(lines))

            return {
                "report_json": json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True, indent=2),
                "production_ready": review.production_ready,
                "exec_out": True,
            }
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"Selection report failed: {exc}")
            return {"report_json": "{}", "production_ready": False, "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Asset_Selection_Report
